verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for a search API product, so the axis applies. None of the evidence pack's docs, community posts or probes mention a telemetry opt-out, a data-retention control or a usage-tracking setting. The items cover search features, integrations and pricing only.
